headline: ‘Fauda’ Braves Oct. 7, and Audiences’ Attitudes Toward Israel
context: The new season of the Israeli hit depicts the Hamas attacks and aftermath. It arrives as Israel’s artists face resistance overseas precisely because of how the country responded to Oct. 7.
